localDoulas.name: Melissa Sandoval
localDoulas.bio: I'm a DONA certified birth doula (CD) and postpartum doula based in North Las Vegas with over 10 years of experience. I provide full doula service from the third trimester through 6 weeks postpartum throughout the Las Vegas valley.

localDoulas.name: Melissa Smith
localDoulas.bio: I've been in the birth work field for 12 years and have spent the last 5 years focused specifically on postpartum care. I'm known as the Placenta Lady, offering placenta encapsulation and postpartum support in North Las Vegas.

localDoulas.name: Alicia R.
localDoulas.bio: We are a family-owned business in North Las Vegas that provides doula and lactation services to the community, supporting families through birth, postpartum, and early feeding journeys.

localDoulas.name: Carla Parker
localDoulas.bio: Bilingual (English and Spanish) DONA-certified birth and postpartum doula with 6 years of experience serving families in North Las Vegas and the greater Las Vegas valley.
